sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The open-weight, single-GPU sibling of Qwen3.8-Max, published by Alibaba on Hugging Face on Aug 14 2026 under Apache 2.0 — the smaller open release Alibaba had promised alongside the closed Qwen3.8-Max flagship. sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: the same answers, 37% less thinking
sources.snippet: The second model in our ThinkingCap series. We took Qwen3.8-27B and cut how much it thinks, without changing the quality of the answers.
